name: Overheard
long_description:
Overheard supercharges your team’s capacity for high-quality customer research. Tell it what you’re deciding, like why customers churn or which launch to back. It interviews dozens of people at once by voice, from your own customers or a research panel, and comes back with answers.

Most teams have more decisions than research capacity, so many still get made on gut feel. Overheard helps research teams cover far more of them, and gives teams without researchers a way to start.

Teams use Overheard to find out why customers churn or don’t convert, choose between ideas before a launch, set pricing, and run win/loss interviews.
